title: Luganda for English speakers
description: Luganda is the language of Buganda in central Uganda, spoken by millions in and around Kampala.
notes: All Luganda in this course was drafted by Claude and needs a native-speaker review (see the checklists in journal/).

why.title: The language of **Kampala’s streets.**
why.text: Luganda is spoken by millions of people across central Uganda and is the most widely spoken language in Kampala. Learn it to talk with family, make friends at the market, or feel at home on your next trip.

cards.title: For families
cards.text: Reconnect with grandparents and pass the language on.

cards.title: For travellers
cards.text: Greet, bargain and get around with confidence.

cards.title: For the curious
cards.text: Discover noun classes, tones and proverbs.

landing.farewell: Weebale nnyo — thank you very much.
landing.audience: Complete beginners, diaspora families reconnecting with the language, and visitors to Uganda who want more than “hello”.
landing.first: Greetings, introductions and numbers, then family, food, the market, time, places and more, unit by unit.

sections.title: Foundations
sections.description: Greetings, people, food, numbers, time, places, the home and health.

sections.title: Everyday life
sections.description: Describe things, get dressed, talk about your day, the weather, animals, work, school and travel.

sections.title: Conversations
sections.description: Say no, ask questions, talk about the past and the future, feelings, hobbies, phone calls and cooking.

sections.title: Community and culture
sections.description: Clans and totems, the kingdom, farming, celebrations, music, faith, business and nature.

sections.title: Confident speaker
sections.description: Compare, imagine, tell stories, use proverbs, follow the news, handle emergencies and show respect.
